thread:
Alex G.: FYI Helio Labs signed up an hour ago via console. They have an API key that shows up in the dashboard but all requests return 403 'project_mismatch'. Customer expects traffic to be billed to project 'helio-prod' but console lists the key under 'default-sandbox'.
Maya S.: Can you paste the org/tenant id and the key id? Curious if this is the provisioning claim binding race we saw last week.
Alex G.: Org: org_0H1xQk, key_id: sk_live_9abCde, console project shown: default-sandbox, expected: helio-prod. Quick repro I ran:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_9abCde" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}' | jq .
```
Response: `{"error":{"code":403,"message":"project_mismatch: key bound to project default-sandbox"}}`
Maya S.: Ok thanks. That looks like the same symptom as PROV-4678 (claim binding to default project during fast signup). Ben, can you check the provisioner logs for org_0H1xQk around 2351239000-2351239900?
Ben P.: On it. Allocating to provisioning team. Possible causes: delayed claim assignment from OIDC flow or fallback to default when the requested project name is not yet created. Will pull the binding events. @provision-bot can you attach the provisioning trace?
provision-bot: Ticket created PROV-4829. Retrieved events for org_0H1xQk: bind_attempt@2351239231 -> bind_success@2351239240 (project=default-sandbox). No later rebind event found. Attachment: /provision/logs/2351239231-trace.log
Maya S.: Two possible fixes: 1) Rebind existing key to helio-prod via admin API (safe, short-term). 2) Re-run the onboarding pipeline with explicit project creation step then rebind (safer for audit). Quick admin rebind example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/admin/keys/rebind 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"key_id":"sk_live_9abCde","project_id":"helio-prod"}'
```
Ben P.: I'll run a controlled rebind and record the audit entry, then confirm with the customer. Also adding a short-term alert rule to flag new keys bound to 'default-sandbox' so support can catch this earlier.
Alex G.: I ran the admin rebind (Ben confirmed permission). After rebind the same curl returns 200 and a valid completion token. Customer confirmed on the call that requests now succeed.
Maya S.: Filing follow-up action: add pre-claim check in onboarding pipeline to avoid fallback to sandbox when customer supplies a project_name. Created ticket PROV-4830.
Alex G.: Closing loop with Helio. They accepted the rebind and asked for audit log export for compliance — attaching the rebind audit event ID: AUDIT-2026-2351242.
Ben P.: Leaving a note for infra: we should consider retrying the async project-create step before binding if the create timestamp < 60s. Marking as postmortem candidate.
infra-bot: Postmortem draft created: PM-2351. Assigned to provisioning and devex.
Alex G.: Thanks team :thumbsup: I updated the support ticket and marked it resolved for now.
